areas.name: Decarbonization
areas.reason: General objective relevant; some specific objectives and indicators on industrial decarbonization, but small relative scale and mostly tied to renewable-energy value chain, so impact limited.

areas.name: Competitiveness
areas.reason: Credit for small firms' energy efficiency and digitalization with a productivity target; reach is relatively limited within the overall program, so impact restricted.

areas.name: Clean energy
areas.reason: General objective directly aligned; a bit over a quarter of resources go to renewable generation, efficiency and low-carbon fuels with specific indicators; impact high, building on existing credit lines.

areas.name: Digital inclusion and connectivity
areas.reason: Strong alignment: over a third of resources fund connectivity for public units, digital platforms and private digital credit; specific objectives and indicators; impact considered high.

areas.name: Digital government
areas.reason: Objective directly related; secure networks, digital governance and municipal service integration with targets; impact moderate given the limited weight of these initiatives in the program.

areas.name: Health (SUS)
areas.reason: Digital-health projects exist, but no specific objectives, indicators or targets to measure effects on public health access.

areas.name: Secondary/technical education
areas.reason: Education-related credit lines exist, but scale is very limited, with few beneficiary institutions, so no structural impact.

areas.name: Women
areas.reason: Women-led business support is mentioned but not formalized in components, products or targets; a women-entrepreneur credit line was not linked to indicators.

areas.name: Sustainable cities
areas.reason: Urban mobility and electric bus financing appear, but no specific objectives, indicators or targets measure impact on sustainable cities.

areas.name: Disaster resilience and climate adaptation
areas.reason: Climate benefits are indirect effects of energy-transition projects; no adaptation or risk-management initiatives are planned.

areas.name: Science, technology and innovation
areas.reason: Research and innovation support is planned, but no specific objectives, indicators or targets measure effects on the science and technology system.

areas.name: Labor
areas.reason: Jobs objective and indicator do not match planned actions; job creation is an indirect effect of energy projects, with no lines targeting productive inclusion of the poor.

areas.name: Regional equity
areas.reason: Objectives and indicators address less developed municipalities, but only a small share of resources is directed there, insufficient to be a relevant instrument of regional equity.

areas.name: Mining
areas.reason: Innovation financing for extraction exists, but no specific objectives, indicators or targets tied to the mining sector area.

areas.name: State capacity
areas.reason: Some adherence through public-service digitalization, but the elements were counted under digital government to avoid double counting.

areas.name: International cooperation and regional development
areas.reason: No direct link between green hydrogen and biofuel support, though export-oriented, and promotion of international cooperation.
